assertions.subject: Crohn's disease
assertions.quote: The incidence of enterovesical fistula among patients with Crohn's disease ranges from 2% to 5%.

assertions.subject: Malignancy
assertions.quote: Malignancy, including colorectal and small bowel cancers, represents the second most common cause of colovesical and enterovesical fistulas, accounting for approximately 10% to 20% of cases.
